column1: Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together.
Beat the butter and sugar on high about 2 minutes until creamy.
Add the eggs, sour cream, vanilla, and almond extract and beat on medium-high until combined; it may look curdled.
Mix in the dry ingredients on low until a thick, smooth dough forms.
Cover the dough and chill for at least 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment or silicone mats.
Scoop 1.5 tbsp portions of dough and space them 3 inches apart.
Bake 13–14 minutes until the cookies spring back when lightly pressed.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack to cool completely.
Spread vanilla buttercream on the cooled cookies and add sprinkles if desired.
